keywordSummary.publicationStatus: Local integration only. North/South Dakota work comes before GitHub upload and CI, as requested.

counties.name: Allen County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the venue-use category and request a complete staffed period before a quote.
counties.rationale: Cleveland explains room hire versus production; Kanabec explains attendance, furniture and setup time. Allen adds an estimator-ready combination of use category, five-hour base period and changed technician provision after the base interval.

counties.name: Anderson County
counties.readerDecision: Choose an ordinary museum visit or request an off-season appointment at the intended property.
counties.rationale: Rice already ties the intended historic property to its usable visit instructions; Sabine handles closed-day group appointments; Houston handles delivery format. Combining their existing guidance answers the documented decisions without another county service page.

counties.name: Atchison County
counties.readerDecision: Choose self-directed digital exploration or request an interactive live virtual experience.
counties.rationale: Houston distinguishes audience and delivery setting; Brown distinguishes tour products. Atchison adds a self-directed digital resource versus staff-led question/customization session, with distinct viewing, request and joining preparation.

counties.name: Barber County
counties.readerDecision: Maintain a local lodging-referral list when an external campground retires permanently.
counties.rationale: Ashe already explains retiring one offer while correcting an external listing and assigning update ownership. Barber concerns permanent campground and ride retirement rather than one discontinued service, but the supported website work is still removal or correction of a stale external referral. The itinerary-dependency guide covers checking arrangements controlled by another operator. No additional service page is justified by the supported referral-maintenance work.

counties.name: Barton County
counties.readerDecision: Prepare a school day that fits a learning aim, delivery setting, program blocks and travel limits.
counties.rationale: Freeborn covers rotations and seasonal programs; Rogers covers grade/activity group limits; Houston covers delivery setting. Barton adds an editable day outline that makes arrival, multiple lessons, lunch and departure jointly reviewable by teacher and educator.

counties.name: Bourbon County
counties.readerDecision: Request a narrated trip or hire for transport using the correct charge unit and route information.
counties.rationale: Brown compares tour products and Payne separates assistance from booking; Osage distinguishes payment counts. Bourbon adds a quote preparation sequence joining intended use, charge unit, route and an additional guide, rather than a visitor ticket summary.

counties.name: Brown County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish a regular monthly room series, additional meetings and single events before requesting dates.
counties.rationale: Karnes addresses preparation and recurring requests without automatic approval; Van Zandt separates renewal from new requests; Kanabec addresses room setup. Brown adds three explicit request patterns with different advance windows and an occurrence-specific priority/change process.

counties.name: Butler County
counties.readerDecision: Prepare a targeted lookup, broader research question or photo request without mistaking planned indexes for live searches.
counties.rationale: Andrew and Blue Earth handle research visits; Otter Tail handles partial indexes; Pawnee distinguishes a known payment from an initial inquiry. Butler combines publication state with the job a researcher is being commissioned to perform, giving an owner a concrete holdings and request-category project.

counties.name: Chase County
counties.readerDecision: Choose an available preserve experience without assuming an unconfirmed van tour is operating.
counties.rationale: Murray and Oklahoma Comanche already explain partial access and a still-usable visit; the experience-product and itinerary-dependency guides cover unresolved availability and alternate arrangements. The source supports those established choices but not enough extra owner-facing work for another page.

counties.name: Chautauqua County
counties.readerDecision: Choose participation in a local recorded-story project rather than assume a conservation ranch offers visitor bookings.
counties.rationale: Meeker already separates recorded-story contribution from research and explains the approval/use process; Coal distinguishes new recording from existing material. The local invitation adds a short preferred story length but no substantial new commissioning or editorial process.

counties.name: Cherokee County
counties.readerDecision: Choose museum admission or the appropriate camping hookup category and contact the operator for a reservation.
counties.rationale: Hughes already develops utility-based campsite choice and pending versus accepted requests; Latimer handles stay and arrival arrangements; Roseau distinguishes a museum visit from other visitor expectations. The Big Brutus choices are useful locally but do not create a substantial new website-project principle.

counties.name: Cheyenne County
counties.readerDecision: Decide whether a museum visit fits available time or whether a separate local-history research visit is needed.
counties.rationale: The motorcycle FAQ gives visit preparation already addressed by the experience-product guide. Rice/Sabine cover seasonal or appointment access and Blue Earth covers checking research material. No additional coherent website commission emerges beyond these completed records.

counties.name: Clark County
counties.readerDecision: Prepare a museum visit or obtain a local-history publication by the appropriate route.
counties.rationale: Hampshire and the class-take-home guide already treat collection/transport responsibilities; Otter Tail covers published indexes and research resources. The publication’s pickup/shipping price difference by itself would be a thin policy paraphrase rather than a substantial service commission.

counties.name: Clay County
counties.readerDecision: Choose free on-site research, paid staff help or a separate meeting-room inquiry.
counties.rationale: DeKalb already handles paid research scope; Otter Tail handles incomplete holdings; Kanabec develops room-capacity and approval preparation. Hampshire and Monroe cover the pottery firing/return cycle. These complete comparisons leave no distinct new service brief from the supported museum facts.

counties.name: Cloud County
counties.readerDecision: Request a free staff name check or explicitly commission further paid archival work.
counties.rationale: Otter Tail separates index search and further research; DeKalb separates in-person and remote fees; Pawnee separates payment from an initial inquiry. Cloud adds a complete staff-name-check-to-paid-research decision with two distinct request routes, clear boundaries for existing holdings and a record of the earlier response.

counties.name: Coffey County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish a known gap in surviving newspapers from undigitized holdings or an unsuccessful search.
counties.rationale: Otter Tail explains partial digitization, Wise separates current research access from a lost building, and Blue Earth prepares a material request. Coffey adds documented missing issues, incomplete holdings and a source-specific alternative search without implying an answer exists.

counties.name: Comanche County
counties.readerDecision: Complete the correct permit task at the correct place with any required equipment.
counties.rationale: Beaver distinguishes fee basis, Lac Qui Parle distinguishes first-come use from reservations and Latimer distinguishes stay/arrival destinations. Comanche adds an actionable task-to-office matrix where a particular item must physically accompany the permit request.

counties.name: Cowley County
counties.readerDecision: Understand trail restrictions separately from an event that has ended or stopped accepting registration.
counties.rationale: Murray and Oklahoma Comanche already separate usable areas from closed parts; the farm-event guide fully handles ended/confirmed/unconfirmed states. The capacity reason is useful factual context but does not create enough additional project guidance for another county page.

counties.name: Crawford County
counties.readerDecision: Find the correct building and responsible operator within a shared downtown development.
counties.rationale: Clay Minnesota separates two organizations in one building; Rice separates historic sites; Roseau separates an exhibit from a working facility. Crawford adds a building/activity/operator map and a distinct room-arrival content commission within a multi-building district.

counties.name: Decatur County
counties.readerDecision: Choose one-time municipal payment, registered utility access, automatic EFT or bank bill pay through the proper channel.
counties.rationale: Stonewall already distinguishes a payment method from bank draft and bill-pay posting; the inquiry-confirmation guide separates request from completion. Rice, Sabine and Kanabec cover the original seasonal-property and room alternatives. Additional payment-channel labels and registration fields do not add a distinct project beyond that full coverage.

counties.name: Dickinson County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a research appointment from museum entry or a bundled carousel visit.
counties.rationale: Blue Earth and Andrew already cover appointment/material preparation. Osage and the experience-product guide cover the actual paid unit and inclusions. The carousel example is clear but would mostly restate a bundled admission policy without adding substantial owner preparation.

counties.name: Doniphan County
counties.readerDecision: Find whether a selected object is borrowed, locally held or used in the building before choosing a branch.
counties.rationale: Cochran distinguishes provider access, Hennepin distinguishes training and independent use, Rice distinguishes destination. Doniphan adds item-level use mode and a local-hold exception without assuming district-wide inventory or branch availability.

counties.name: Douglas County
counties.readerDecision: Understand kit collection, painted-item return and final collection as separate commitments.
counties.rationale: Hampshire explains finished-piece collection; Monroe distinguishes student return glazing from studio finishing; the class-take-home guide explains post-class responsibility. Douglas adds a take-home order’s three physical handoffs and the record needed to match the returned object to completion.

counties.name: Edwards County
counties.readerDecision: Use digitized local history first and ask staff for defined additional research or copies.
counties.rationale: Otter Tail already explains an incomplete digital index followed by research; DeKalb explains charged assistance; Blue Earth explains material preparation. The modest copy/postage detail does not add enough distinct website-project value beyond those full records.

counties.name: Elk County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the right resource and credential, then use the correct fallback if database access fails.
counties.rationale: Cochran distinguishes provider credentials and Kleberg distinguishes database access from another card program. Elk adds three explicitly named access modes and a resource-specific fallback, developed into safe support intake and a maintained link directory.

counties.name: Ellis County
counties.readerDecision: Determine what the camp interval covers and whether an early-arrival night needs a separate arrangement.
counties.rationale: Cass handles camp funding and Latimer handles arrival/stay choices; the timed-booking guide preserves arrival preparation. Ellis adds the edge of the residential program interval and a separate accepted transport/dorm arrangement before that interval.

counties.name: Ellsworth County
counties.readerDecision: Compare meeting inclusions before choosing the room and meal.
counties.rationale: Adds meeting-service inclusions versus optional meals and room access, rather than another event capacity table or allocation request.

counties.name: Finney County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the visit mode attached to its entrance and operating window.
counties.rationale: Adds a concrete mode-to-entrance-to-hours brief and separates third-party attraction operation; Major focuses on group/private use and Payne on trip assistance.

counties.name: Ford County
counties.readerDecision: Carry the seasonal package choice into the group arrival plan.
counties.rationale: Adds season-dependent package selection plus optional interpretation and escort distribution, beyond a generic group-size or scheduled-tour request.

counties.name: Franklin County
counties.readerDecision: Choose an exhibit visit or a prepared archives request.
counties.rationale: Texas/Harrison already provides the complete museum-versus-research destination brief, including preparation and different locations. Minnesota/Blue Earth addresses checking material before a visit, while Kandiyohi and Morrison cover research, copies and fees. The complete source-backed Franklin proposal would repeat those owner inputs and acceptance checks without a material new project decision.

counties.name: Geary County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the program setting before applying its age, season and group limits.
counties.rationale: Adds per-activity fit constraints plus the physical collection/return requirement to the existing education delivery-format principle; unlike Harvey, this brief concerns suitability before requesting a program, not travel reimbursement.

counties.name: Gove County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the requested work attached to the correct branch.
counties.rationale: Adds a concrete same-town, different-address branch decision and network-versus-local capability review, beyond choosing a sales/service department at one supplier.

counties.name: Graham County
counties.readerDecision: Match the time available to the public Nicodemus visit route.
counties.rationale: The complete Roger Mills and Olmsted records already distinguish interior access, outdoor routes, available interpretation and visit preparation. Payne covers assistance inquiries. The supported Graham improvements would repeat time, purpose and availability prompts; a new general guide or county body would not add substantial owner preparation or evaluation value.

counties.name: Grant County
counties.readerDecision: Start a custom-potting inquiry with the container the customer already has.
counties.rationale: Adds a supplied-object service brief: an existing planter changes preparation and handoff, rather than another retail product or venue activity choice.

counties.name: Gray County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a room request from paying a known library charge.
counties.rationale: The complete room-use comparators already cover scheduling, permitted use and staff confirmation, and the inquiry-confirmation guide distinguishes a request, payment or other intermediate action from an accepted arrangement. A proposed library page would repeat those practical steps without adding a material county-specific commissioning decision. The engine lead is excluded for unresolved locality, not claimed to be a duplicate.

counties.name: Greeley County
counties.readerDecision: Choose borrowing, digital access or equipment used at the library.
counties.rationale: Childress and Angelina already explain resource-specific credentials and on-site versus remote use; Coal covers media-work purpose and format preparation. The useful Greeley body would repeat those routing and preparation checks. Unknown conversion formats or loan rules cannot supply invented extra value.

counties.name: Greenwood County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the current cattle sale separate from past results and private-treaty inquiries.
counties.rationale: Adds recurring livestock-sale route and document-year control: current auction materials, historical results and private-treaty availability. Coles addresses competing live-sale claims, Berkshire estate disposition and Madison meat-processing stages.

counties.name: Hamilton County
counties.readerDecision: Connect the requested department to the applicable contact period.
counties.rationale: Adds department-by-contact-period routing with season-dependent availability and branch-reviewed charge exceptions; Tioga covers customer eligibility for emergency service rather than this seasonal policy.

counties.name: Harper County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the event area separate from the permitted overnight campsite.
counties.rationale: Adds the spatial boundary between an event permit and lawful overnight camping; existing records discuss campsite categories, equipment or venue choices without this event-footprint distinction.

counties.name: Harvey County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a museum visit, a classroom loan and the reimbursement follow-up.
counties.rationale: Distinct sequencing of classroom/school loans and reserved-but-not-guaranteed post-trip reimbursement; existing records cover delivery format and program preparation without this combination.

counties.name: Haskell County
counties.readerDecision: Show whether the site project starts with existing plans or needs design work.
counties.rationale: Moves beyond equipment-supplier coordination to project maturity: owner intent, existing plans, survey/design work and earthwork scope.

counties.name: Hodgeman County
counties.readerDecision: Plan the facility period and vehicle permits alongside the guest count.
counties.rationale: Adds a facility-period versus vehicle-permit planning distinction, separate from ordinary event capacity or lodging party-size choices.

counties.name: Jackson County
counties.readerDecision: Explain what the meat price covers before asking for processing choices.
counties.rationale: Adds transaction and weight-basis comparison to processing preparation; the existing records do not replace this inclusive-purchase versus added-fee custom-processing brief.

counties.name: Jefferson County
counties.readerDecision: Describe boat, lift or trailer work separately from slip availability.
counties.rationale: The complete marine-service-intake guide already directly covers asset identification, requested work, location and separate confirmation of dependencies. Mackinac and Buffalo add the complete storage/service and changed-handoff county examples. The proposed Jefferson body would restate this full brief; adding lift as another asset label does not add substantial new owner preparation or evaluation value.

counties.name: Jewell County
counties.readerDecision: Prepare equipment identity and requested work before a repair inquiry.
counties.rationale: North Carolina/Lee, Florida/Union and Texas/Wilson already provide full equipment-context, service-purpose and staff-confirmed inquiry briefs, and the quote-request guide covers useful first-request information. Prior service history is a sensible field but does not turn the same complete commissioning brief into a substantially different page; own-fleet versus outside-fleet service similarly adds no supported new process.

counties.name: Johnson County
counties.readerDecision: Compare studio access and firing charges as separate membership decisions.
counties.rationale: Adds a concrete time-allowance versus production-volume cost comparison and an experience/application route; broader studio or class-choice records do not answer that commissioning brief.

counties.name: Kearny County
counties.readerDecision: Explain when shared-room use makes a piece of equipment unavailable.
counties.rationale: Adds equipment availability dependent on a separately used room, beyond room-booking priority, borrowing inventory or media-format selection.

counties.name: Kingman County
counties.readerDecision: Ask about spectators, stalls and campers as separate event requirements.
counties.rationale: Separates human attendance, animal stalls and overnight vehicles instead of treating a multi-resource arena inquiry as ordinary event capacity.

counties.name: Kiowa County
counties.readerDecision: Explain where a resident lives, works and travels before the application.
counties.rationale: Adds residential program fit across lodging, shared studios and travel before an artistic application, beyond studio membership or a class choice.

counties.name: Labette County
counties.readerDecision: Ask about software compatibility before treating a business form as artwork.
counties.rationale: Adds software compatibility and form-to-window alignment before production; existing custom print advice focuses on product, artwork and finish rather than the system producing the variable content.

counties.name: Lane County
counties.readerDecision: Describe the required output before choosing a copy or reproduction service.
counties.rationale: The local/external production split and reduction of oversized originals adds an output-routing brief beyond research fees, invoice timing and general scan choices.

counties.name: Leavenworth County
counties.readerDecision: Separate the visit arrangement from official installation access.
counties.rationale: Adds an independent access authority and a time-limited registration handoff plus commercial-driver route; existing timed-booking content does not confer access or resolve those responsibilities.

counties.name: Lincoln County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish an exhibit visit, an exhibition proposal and a purchase from the gift gallery.
counties.rationale: Windham explains artist responsibilities for gallery use; Polk connects medium-specific applications to jury samples; Goodhue separates free entry from guided group arrangements. The captures establish service categories but not additional owner preparation or an acceptance case beyond those full records.

counties.name: Linn County
counties.readerDecision: Choose seasonal visitor-center access, year-round battlefield grounds or an accommodation type.
counties.rationale: Delaware separates seasonal museum access from year-round trail access; Pushmataha compares sleeping privacy; Morris TX separates allowed party size from supplied beds and kitchen equipment. The local material supports accurate labels but does not add a substantial commissioning workflow beyond those records.

counties.name: Logan County
counties.readerDecision: Compare venue access for decorating, the event and next-day cleanup.
counties.rationale: Bremer covers food and staffing choices, Chisago compares room rates with included and additional services, Ida covers rental access and meal equipment, and Craig covers room configuration, surfaces and optional kitchen use. This brief adds a worked comparison of identically named multi-day packages, a separate third-day cleanup window, and kitchen cleanup versus included teardown. The complete project helps an owner prepare approved package labels and test a change between them.

counties.name: Lyon County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the child’s age, accompanying adult and class status with the chosen session.
counties.rationale: Wisconsin/Iowa connects a canceled workshop to the separate lodging decision; Whiteside distinguishes prior preparation from current companion enrollment; Mille Lacs preserves class sizes for optional lessons. The local brief combines a class-specific age range with an across-catalogue under-six accompaniment rule and a noon-before enrollment checkpoint. It gives concrete owner inputs and acceptance cases beyond general confirmation wording.

counties.name: Marion County
counties.readerDecision: Explain a historic hotel tour around the hotel’s guest turnover.
counties.rationale: Mason covers tour minimums and multi-venue coordination; Horry covers private versus shared event access; Pine covers museum and café hours. This brief adds the operational dependency of touring guest rooms between hotel stays and a website acceptance case that distinguishes accommodation inventory, tour access and dining.

counties.name: Marshall County
counties.readerDecision: Plan the desired museum floor and parking suitable for the arriving vehicle.
counties.rationale: Iowa/Marion already gives component-specific historic access, Kaufman covers coach arrival and tailored groups, and Sequoyah plus departure-address preserve route-specific access and meeting points. A new county brief would mainly recombine those same acceptance checks.

counties.name: McPherson County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish an ordinary mill visit from the annual operating demonstration.
counties.rationale: Roseau distinguishes exhibits from production visits; Creek distinguishes viewing from driving; Hopkins distinguishes ordinary access from event-only interiors. This candidate adds a once-yearly preservation demonstration that does not manufacture the pictured product, with a specific event-only age boundary and a media/update acceptance case.

counties.name: Meade County
counties.readerDecision: Identify the chosen museum site and what its route physically includes.
counties.rationale: Parker, Henry and Rice already distinguish historic components, conditional building access and separate site addresses. Applying their complete route checks here would not add a materially different commissioning task.

counties.name: Miami County
counties.readerDecision: Compare the production tour, farm admission and a self-guided visit.
counties.rationale: Roseau covers production-dependent tours; Montgomery TX covers education formats; Steele covers short versus full-day itineraries. This project adds a three-way inclusion comparison where refreshments are shared but the guide and farm admission are not, plus a self-guided alternative unaffected by the guided group minimum.

counties.name: Mitchell County
counties.readerDecision: Find the appropriate hospital service contact without treating emergency hours as every service’s schedule.
counties.rationale: Knox already supplies a fuller service-specific scheduling brief and Olmsted separates visit purposes. The hospital capture is chiefly a service list; the dated pool alternative does not improve on Lampasas’s party preparation. No new workflow is evidenced.

counties.name: Montgomery County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish park access, zoo hours, rides and a reserved facility.
counties.rationale: Tom Green already separates free admission from arranged activities and Faribault distinguishes facility-specific request routes. The captured schedule and payment distinctions add no substantial new owner-preparation sequence beyond those records.

counties.name: Morris County
counties.readerDecision: Choose an on-site event room or an off-site carryout discussion.
counties.rationale: Stearns focuses on alternative layouts within rooms; Bremer on food and staffing choices; Okmulgee on catering counts and deadlines. This brief makes the event location the first choice and distinguishes named room capacities from carryout-only service boundaries, with separate owner inputs for each.

counties.name: Morton County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish a museum introduction from campground arrangements controlled by another operator.
counties.rationale: Boone and Lac qui Parle already contain fuller facility-specific booking and first-come instructions. The captured Morton material lacks actual arrival, payment or group-reservation terms needed to extend those complete workflows.

counties.name: Nemaha County
counties.readerDecision: Carry catalogue references into preparation for a research visit.
counties.rationale: Pawnee OK explains research questions and known charges, Chariton distinguishes holdings and original custodians, Washington separates admission and research appointments. This brief adds the researcher-created catalogue item list and two-week retrieval preparation, plus a practical acceptance test based on specific references rather than a general topic.

counties.name: Neosho County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the teaching loan before planning its borrowing period and shipping.
counties.rationale: Montgomery TX and Deaf Smith distinguish tours, trunks and speakers; Kiowa distinguishes school and festival hosts. This page goes inside the loan category: different resource types carry different periods, member treatment, shipping and return responsibilities. The four-week teaching example provides a concrete acceptance test the broader format pages do not.

counties.name: Ness County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the regular-hours county museum or an appointment at one of the neighboring museums.
counties.rationale: Cooke and Rice already provide complete museum/site appointment briefs. Winkler covers printing preparation in more detail than the library summary. Neither local lead adds enough evidence for a separate commissioning explanation.

counties.name: Norton County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a community-room rental charge from its deposit and a pool party from public swimming.
counties.rationale: Rains and Dallas already explain rental charges versus deposits with fuller preparation; Lampasas covers pool party choices and attendance. The local figures do not create a new useful workflow by themselves.

counties.name: Osage County
counties.readerDecision: Give each historic property its own visitor or rental invitation.
counties.rationale: Parker and Marion IA cover different interiors and routes, while Rice covers two properties and appointment notices. This brief adds mixed ownership and purpose across a heritage route: casual school grounds, a private event property and an overnight rental. It specifies image-to-property labels and acceptance checks that prevent a public invitation spreading to private premises.

counties.name: Osborne County
counties.readerDecision: Find rehabilitation or at-home sleep-study information through the appropriate provider contact.
counties.rationale: Knox and Kent already explain service routing and appropriate private-information handoffs. Adding an Osborne page would require inventing clinical eligibility, referral or equipment steps not supported by these captures.

counties.name: Ottawa County
counties.readerDecision: Explain fax direction and page charges before the document-service visit.
counties.rationale: La Salle covers chargeable output, Madison covers print limits and Crockett covers preparation. This brief adds a direction-specific first-page/additional-page comparison and a three-page acceptance case. It avoids inventing cover-sheet treatment or a remote upload workflow.

counties.name: Pawnee County
counties.readerDecision: Arrange a guided Fort Larned visit rather than assume a guide is available with ordinary access.
counties.rationale: Sabine and Goodhue already distinguish ordinary visiting from arranged groups, while Stearns supplies a more developed facility brief. The fort and center lead to existing contact choices without an additional substantial commissioning workflow.

counties.name: Phillips County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the scheduled pool-party count separate from a price-band limit.
counties.rationale: Lampasas defines who is counted; Johnson combines attendance and duration; Okmulgee distinguishes an estimate from a guaranteed count. This brief adds a different boundary: paying within an up-to-fifty band does not authorize attendance up to fifty when staff scheduled fewer. The twenty-nine and fifty-one cases make that distinction reviewable.

counties.name: Pottawatomie County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a canceled performance from a patron’s weather-related change of plan.
counties.rationale: Jeff Davis covers changed programs, customer response deadlines and waitlists; Stone covers a staged tour exit; Lyon MN covers room closure notices. This brief links an external performance-status channel to the separate patron-contact and usher-seating routes, without importing a cancellation or refund outcome from another venue.

counties.name: Pratt County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a young-artist nomination from a proposed full exhibition.
counties.rationale: Polk covers medium-specific jury applications and samples; Kerr covers different gift purposes and reviewers; Bosque covers award choices and their price consequences. This brief adds third-party nomination versus self-application and a defined youth mini-exhibit versus full exhibition, with acceptance tests that keep the review and public announcement separate.

counties.name: Rawlins County
counties.readerDecision: Route a refill question through the pharmacy and keep other clinic tasks distinct.
counties.rationale: Knox separates facility hours from service schedules; Kent separates resident visits, tours and admissions. This brief adds an external pharmacy-to-provider request sequence and a different result-access route, with explicit acceptance checks that avoid medical authorization and record availability claims.

counties.name: Reno County
counties.readerDecision: Show the time underground as well as the reserved descent and earlier check-in.
counties.rationale: Bland and Baylor distinguish last starts from closing; Collin distinguishes membership purchase channels; Sequoyah preserves itinerary-specific access. This brief adds an explicit mismatch between recommended visit length and time remaining after the final descent, with a concrete 3-to-5 acceptance case and an earlier-choice explanation.

counties.name: Republic County
counties.readerDecision: Choose a museum visit, group arrangement or archive inquiry.
counties.rationale: The complete comparators already explain separately operated historic spaces, group versus research purposes and preparation. A building inventory and contact categories do not add a substantial worked commission.

counties.name: Rice County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish available teaching resources from arranging a class visit.
counties.rationale: Eastland already separates live resources from future plans, Scott prepares lesson selection and Goodhue explains arranged guided visits. The accessible Rice evidence supplies no additional complete owner procedure.

counties.name: Riley County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the event space, access period and exhibit inclusion together.
counties.rationale: Washington separates room and exhibit access; Riley adds public-hours admission allowances versus after-hours full-building/exhibit access and setup-dependent room counts. The commission tests three linked quantities rather than only a rental checkbox.

counties.name: Rooks County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish self-requested wellness tests from clinician-ordered services.
counties.rationale: The direct-service/referral comparators do not connect request origin, recipient of results and payment category in a medically reviewed public-information brief. Added value is the owner approval map and a nonclinical acceptance case.

counties.name: Rush County
counties.readerDecision: Prepare the host space before requesting a traveling museum exhibit.
counties.rationale: Scott compares learning kits by grade; Houston and Kiowa compare teaching delivery and host types. Rush adds physical exhibit hosting and the unconfirmed transport/setup/return responsibility sequence, with a concrete space acceptance case.

counties.name: Russell County
counties.readerDecision: Choose a rental room or a prepared group visit.
counties.rationale: The two-room rental lacks a distinctive agenda or equipment dependency beyond the full venue comparators. The alternate visit preparation is already explained more completely by Olmsted and the experience guide.

counties.name: Saline County
counties.readerDecision: Keep group size and advance notice attached to the chosen zoo program.
counties.rationale: Kendall already covers experience-specific age/count rules. This full brief adds a worked distinction between ordinary group-rate qualification and a narrower educational program, plus different notice and school routes; it is not justified by the zoo label alone.

counties.name: Scott County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish the museum’s pueblo model from visiting the archaeological site.
counties.rationale: Cimarron already gives the full two-destination activity/overnight brief; Steele covers separate historical sites and itinerary ownership. A model-versus-site distinction is useful but the sources do not add enough journey detail to improve on those complete records.

counties.name: Sedgwick County
counties.readerDecision: Give accompanying adults the admission instructions for their chosen route.
counties.rationale: Ramsey routes parent payment through school; Wabasha distinguishes entry from reserved seats. This local brief combines an explicit alternative member-entry route with school coordination and theater entitlement, producing a distinct parent communication commission.

counties.name: Seward County
counties.readerDecision: Show the final tour start separately from closing time.
counties.rationale: Lake handles guided versus independent access and Logan late arrival after ticketing. Seward adds pre-arrival final-start planning and conditional character staffing with a separate free-museum choice, yielding concrete owner inputs and review cases.

counties.name: Shawnee County
counties.readerDecision: Explain a school-only day without promising exclusive use.
counties.rationale: Existing school comparators cover class/program limits. The additional local value is distinguishing school-only access from exclusive use and testing that alongside a multi-session optional program.

counties.name: Sheridan County
counties.readerDecision: Choose public computer access, a room request or a library resource.
counties.rationale: The full technology-access and credential comparators provide more substantive task guidance. A listed 3D printer does not establish file, material, payment or approval requirements and cannot support an invented commission.

counties.name: Sherman County
counties.readerDecision: Check the museum’s local time and visit arrangement.
counties.rationale: The full timed-booking guide explicitly covers time zones, and Olmsted/McClain cover purpose-specific schedules. The alternate gallery-rental mention does not add a developed local project.

counties.name: Smith County
counties.readerDecision: Choose lodging from actual layout or prepare a daylight visit to a private historic site.
counties.rationale: The lodging facts fit the existing capacity/layout comparison without new constraints. The alternate daylight private-property visit is covered by the access-mode guide and Major’s fuller day-use brief.

counties.name: Stafford County
counties.readerDecision: Separate refuge visiting from archive research.
counties.rationale: Major already explains outdoor access boundaries, and the complete archive comparators cover appointment, research and reproduction requests in greater depth. A collection size is not new website-project value.

counties.name: Stanton County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the visit purpose before using a hospital’s hours or contact.
counties.rationale: McClain distinguishes branches by day; the service/referral comparators distinguish responsible provider. Stanton supplies a fuller purpose-first administrative flow across appointments, visiting and prospective-care tours, with address ownership and a no-eligibility-promise acceptance check.

counties.name: Stevens County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the resource and use its own credential instructions.
counties.rationale: Cochran already gives a full provider-specific credential and recovery brief; Texas distinguishes access continuity and eligibility. The archive title inventory and lending categories do not establish a new preparation workflow.

counties.name: Sumner County
counties.readerDecision: Prepare the document before changing the device’s connection.
counties.rationale: Winkler explains unavailable wireless printing and branch capabilities; La Salle explains chargeable output; Wood separates equipment permission from sequential use. Sumner adds a concrete dependency inside a device-help sequence: prepare online material before changing to a network that may lose internet, retain readable instructions during the switch, then provide an approved fallback. It is a complete owner-input and usability-check brief, not a printer-policy paraphrase.

counties.name: Thomas County
counties.readerDecision: Request archival help separately from booking the event room.
counties.rationale: Cottonwood covers setup and tours, Washington exhibit access and Morrison archive billing. Thomas links a venue commission to optional archive-supported event content, preserving separate deliverables and room access rather than combining those existing policies verbatim.

counties.name: Trego County
counties.readerDecision: Connect the campground entrance to the after-office arrival instructions.
counties.rationale: Owsley addresses vehicle approach and San Jacinto first-night access restrictions. Trego adds a concrete physical information handoff after reaching the correct entrance, with a missing-packet review case and owner-approved cutoff.

counties.name: Wabaunsee County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish buying in the store from collecting an online order.
counties.rationale: Linn offers online pickup and shipping; Alma explicitly does not offer pickup of online orders. The full commission adds channel distinction, dispatch wording and gift-inquiry boundaries without inventing a new service.

counties.name: Wallace County
counties.readerDecision: Plan museum hours and a separate private-property outdoor visit.
counties.rationale: The existing time-zone guide and complete day-use/two-destination records already explain the decisions supported here. Neither a geographic superlative nor an old highway detour supplies extra commissioning value.

counties.name: Washington County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish seasonal visiting, arranged group tours and an educational presentation.
counties.rationale: Hollenberg supplies seasonal and arranged-group choices, including winter scheduling and specialized themes. These fit the complete existing visit and program preparation guidance; the KSDS audience and delivery choices likewise fit Houston and Kiowa. The retained material does not establish a substantial additional worked commission beyond those complete alternatives.

counties.name: Wichita County
counties.readerDecision: Choose museum hours, research-library hours or an appointment at the historic house.
counties.rationale: The complete historic-campus and purpose-based visit comparators already give more useful owner inputs and checks for this decision. Cake-pan lending alone is not substantial project evidence.

counties.name: Wilson County
counties.readerDecision: Keep a camping restriction beside its specific exception route.
counties.rationale: Kittson covers construction status and Sibley seasonal permission. Wilson adds an explicitly undated closure, board exception and event-specific availability with unaffected facility routes; the useful commission is the status-resolution and direct-rate-link review, not an assertion that the old notice is current.

counties.name: Woodson County
counties.readerDecision: Compare a park stay and a separately operated cabin.
counties.rationale: The accessible unit layout comparison is already developed fully in Pushmataha and Big Stone; Caddo covers stay-specific preparation. Do not turn a tourism listing or an inaccessible brochure into assumed bathroom, access or booking restrictions.

counties.name: Wyandotte County
counties.readerDecision: Explain what stays public while a school program uses the library.
counties.rationale: Houston covers educational delivery setting and Cottonwood private rental overlap. Wyandotte adds two public audiences sharing an inflatable-program footprint, with separate teacher and walk-in expectations and a concrete public-use acceptance test.

counties.name: Adams County
counties.readerDecision: Explain the visit schedule before asking a school to choose its activities.
counties.rationale: Freeborn already explains rotations and seasonal options; Mille Lacs covers core visit/add-on capacity and duration; Garfield distinguishes supervision and program counts. The proposed full brief adds an explicit activity-time-versus-schedule-block test, a fixed departure constraint and shared-screening versus private-use explanation. Those owner supplies and acceptance cases add practical scheduling value beyond repeating capacity figures.

counties.name: Antelope County
counties.readerDecision: Should a website distinguish a casual free mill visit from an arranged school group, or a farm-equipment service request from a parts question?
counties.rationale: The fully read Goodhue/Pottawatomie/Murray pages already deliver free-versus-arranged, current access and group preparation guidance. The equipment alternative adds no sufficiently developed local commissioning procedure beyond Aroostook. Neither the free mill nor the dealer address justifies another full page.

counties.name: Arthur County
counties.readerDecision: Put the purpose of the contact before the branch’s general inquiry form.
counties.rationale: Clay separates different organizations sharing a location; Olmsted separates appointment purposes; Loving explains a changed records portal. Arthur adds a practical public-contact brief for restricted staffed hours, self-service facilities and urgent support that must not inherit lobby availability. The owner supplies a task-to-destination record, and tests check phone access without collecting customer account data.

counties.name: Banner County
counties.readerDecision: How should a history venue distinguish ordinary museum access from a prepared school-day program?
counties.rationale: Stephens already develops a school-year program and trip-preparation brief; San Augustine separates school/public experiences; Murray covers seasonal and self-guided access. The county facts support a useful local content edit but do not yet add a substantial complete scope beyond those existing pages.

counties.name: Blaine County
counties.readerDecision: Should a shared courthouse page distinguish the intended service, its visiting dates and the applicable test cutoff before someone plans a trip?
counties.rationale: NO_ADDITION after a complete current alternative was assessed. Clay’s full main body and FAQ already separate responsible organizations at one address; Olmsted connects visit purpose to its own hours, appointments and access conditions. The fully read timed-handoff guide covers activity preparation and earlier arrival, and the maintenance guide covers current information ownership. The authored Arthur brief also supplies a stronger local worked example of restricted staffed hours versus other support routes. Blaine’s rotating dates and earlier test cutoff are meaningful content details, but the resulting owner supplies and acceptance test remain a modest application of those complete scopes rather than a sufficiently developed additional service page. The lodge’s sleeping/activity/meeting choices are already developed by Butler, Pushmataha, Caldwell and Buckingham; its remaining offer-currency uncertainty is not used as the reason to reject the independently complete DMV alternative.

counties.name: Boone County
counties.readerDecision: Would a local equipment-service page add useful commissioning guidance beyond branch, machine and planned-versus-fault preparation?
counties.rationale: Aroostook already provides a complete machine/branch and seasonal-versus-fault brief, Union separates shop/mobile arrangements, and Castro covers parts/pivot/repair distinctions. The two Boone operators do not supply enough additional workflow detail to exceed that guidance. Chase’s separate proposed brief specifically develops 24/7 technical support versus field dispatch, so Boone would also overlap the new cohort.

counties.name: Box Butte County
counties.readerDecision: Make the self-guided map and building descriptions work as one visitor aid.
counties.rationale: Murray, Hopkins and Parker already explain guided/self-guided or grounds/interior access. The substantive increment here is commissioning and maintaining a usable map-to-description system across paper and phone, including preparation before arrival and checks for mismatched stop numbers. That is a different deliverable from another opening-hours explanation.

counties.name: Boyd County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the current sign-in route clear while a business transition is still underway.
counties.rationale: Loving concerns accounts that do not transfer; Nantucket transfers service responsibility; Howard labels continuing and ended offers; Cook handles account recovery and special registration routes. Boyd adds a staged public transition where brand acquisition precedes system completion and the old identity remains the correct current sign-in choice. Its scope requires an owner-approved condition for retiring a notice and tests retained public entry points without using credentials.

counties.name: Brown County
counties.readerDecision: Should a lodging website separate rooms, a whole bunkhouse, cabins and first-come campsites?
counties.rationale: Pushmataha covers bed/privacy allocation, Floyd covers cabin layout and stay requirements, Lincoln handles seasonal utilities, and Lac qui Parle explains first-come arrangements without a booking promise. These complete records already answer the investigated decisions; no substantive extra local commissioning method emerged.

counties.name: Buffalo County
counties.readerDecision: Compare the equipment, transport and overnight commitment of each experience.
counties.rationale: Caswell compares ordinary camera use with a specialist photo tour; Sequoyah distinguishes attraction and regional itinerary; Lincoln covers accommodation-specific equipment and seasons. The Buffalo brief adds the combined commitment of gear carriage, limited assistance, overnight cold-weather preparation and a provider-controlled return, and tests that changing the selected experience replaces its preparation text. It does not duplicate a generic photography-permission summary.

counties.name: Burt County
counties.readerDecision: Explain where a gift can be used before the shopper buys it.
counties.rationale: Cook handles a course gift-certificate exception; Chatham and Jefferson address shipping/pickup; Cabell separates a finished gift from a participation product; Surry covers incomplete catalogs; Anderson covers production readiness. This proposed retail brief tests the suitability of a gift’s redemption channel against the intended purchase before the gift is bought. It deliberately leaves unstated exclusions for owner confirmation and adds channel inventory and recipient-instruction work.

counties.name: Butler County
counties.readerDecision: Does an art museum need different introductions for a group tour and a collection-research inquiry?
counties.rationale: Mille Lacs and Goodhue already explain group program preparation; Clearwater fully develops format, research question, notice and collection access. The newly read library article establishes holdings but not a distinct commissioning problem or acceptance sequence. A new county page would mainly restate those existing briefs.

counties.name: Cass County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the group type attached to its attendance count and arrival plan.
counties.rationale: Rogers already connects grade/group counts to optional activities; Seminole separates visit, lunch and funding; Madison and Freeborn cover dated farm or seasonal offers. Cass adds a full organizer brief that keeps visit type, paying-count basis, collective arrival and reserved-space versus admission together. Its fictional ten-people-but-fewer-paying-guests test is distinct from a generic group-size question.

counties.name: Cedar County
counties.readerDecision: Can a venue website distinguish an ordinary museum or tasting visit from a private group-space inquiry?
counties.rationale: Stearns and Sherburne already give full room/layout-specific commissioning guidance; Buckingham separates shared participation from private-group arrangements; Murray handles limited regular access. The Cedar alternatives do not reveal sufficient extra process beyond those complete explanations.

counties.name: Chase County
counties.readerDecision: Separate technical support, field service and a planned inspection.
counties.rationale: Aroostook separates current faults from seasonal preparation; Castro distinguishes parts, pivot work and repair; Union distinguishes shop/mobile eligibility. Chase’s complete project centers on technical support versus dispatched work versus a planned inspection, retaining the actual machine location and branch. The proposed check catches the unsupported jump from 24/7 phone support to an immediate on-site response.

counties.name: Cherry County
counties.readerDecision: Would another outfitter brief add substantial value by connecting boat type, river segment, launch and pickup?
counties.rationale: Five additional complete outfitter records were inspected after discovering the substantive Trips page. Lafayette and Hancock already provide launch/finish/transport scopes, Edmonson separates route from overnight format, Caldwell tests option-specific transport details, and McCurtain retains conditions before a requested time. The complete timed-handoff guide also covers earlier arrival and separate equipment/transport. The retreat alternative is covered by Butler/Buckingham. The local facts are real but do not yield enough additional commissioning value to justify another page.

counties.name: Cheyenne County
counties.readerDecision: How should a website distinguish first-come camping and seasonal utilities from a scheduled visit?
counties.rationale: Lincoln and Lac qui Parle cover campsite types, weather/seasonal utilities and first-come behavior. Parker and Goodhue cover separately guided interiors and group visits. The alternative did not add a more developed local owner brief beyond those complete scopes.

counties.name: Clay County
counties.readerDecision: Does a city-facility website need clearer choices between campsite types, community-center areas and equipment-service inquiries?
counties.rationale: Lincoln/Lac qui Parle already develop campsite readiness and arrival; Sherburne/Stearns develop room/facility and equipment distinctions; Castro covers pivot-service choices. The inspected local entries do not establish a substantial additional workflow or owner acceptance test beyond those full pages.

counties.name: Colfax County
counties.readerDecision: Keep day attendance, overnight accommodation and each meal count separate.
counties.rationale: Caldwell compares retreat workspace with beds; Buckingham compares public and private retreat formats; Sherburne and Stearns compare rooms/layouts; Butler describes property and bedrooms. Colfax adds a concrete attendance-by-sitting brief in which meeting, sleeping and individual meal counts differ, with an example of day guests staying for dinner. The owner supplies a schedule and count rules, and the check does not turn one total into all capacities.

counties.name: Cuming County
counties.readerDecision: Should a fabrication website explain the supplied state of a cut part versus a finished coated welded assembly?
counties.rationale: Crawford already provides a complete supplied-component scope covering cut/form/hardware/assembly; Martin adds drawing/finish/installation stages; Bergen separates prototype and repeat production. The TECK source is useful, but a new local page would mostly substitute process names into those complete owner briefs without an additional demonstrated decision.

counties.name: Custer County
counties.readerDecision: Separate the artwork reference from the object’s size, use and finish.
counties.rationale: Alcona separates blanks from finished work; Martin explains fabrication and installation stages; Bartholomew separates repair/design starting points; Montgomery separates conversion from developing a design. Custer’s authored project helps a customer name what a visual reference contributes while keeping artwork, physical object, setting and finish separate. The smaller-indoor-object test prevents a gallery reference from silently transferring all specifications.

counties.name: Dakota County
counties.readerDecision: Welcome an early part inquiry while keeping dimension verification explicit.
counties.rationale: Montgomery discusses format conversion versus design creation; Bergen handles prototype/repeat stages and revisions; Bartholomew welcomes rough ideas; Crawford labels supplied operations. The RFQ guide already establishes the general verification principle. Dakota adds a complete local commissioning example around the coexistence of a no-CAD starting route and explicit dimension responsibility, with a revised-dimension check and concrete owner supplies. This is a local worked application, not a proposed new general guide.

counties.name: Dawes County
counties.readerDecision: Would a seasonal museum visit and numbered audio-tour introduction justify a distinct website brief?
counties.rationale: Murray/Hopkins/Parker already give complete seasonal/grounds/interior-access briefs. The audio page supplies content titles but no substantially distinct commissioning sequence; the proposed Box Butte page already develops the better-supported map/phone preparation and upkeep problem. A Dawes page would add little beyond those complete records.

counties.name: Dawson County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the event space with its seasonal enclosure and catering responsibilities.
counties.rationale: Adds a date-dependent enclosure check and a concrete caterer/venue responsibility handoff. Chisago compares room services, Bremer compares floors and staffing, Augusta compares package access, and Kay compares setup capacities; none of those full records works through a photograph showing a different seasonal enclosure.

counties.name: Deuel County
counties.readerDecision: Match the waste material and the user to the right collection route.
counties.rationale: Clark distinguishes a conditional no-charge equipment offer and Knox distinguishes building access from a specific service. This draft develops a different complete task: matching several material streams to locations, applying customer eligibility separately, and testing a mixed load against the organic-only rule.

counties.name: Dixon County
counties.readerDecision: Show the campground, arrival payment route and seasonal facilities together.
counties.rationale: Extends the campsite-category comparison into arrival payment location and the year-round camping/seasonal modern-facility boundary. The full Calhoun and Crow Wing records address stay and site fit, while Faribault routes different facility requests; the proposed check specifically tests a late-season first-come arrival.

counties.name: Dodge County
counties.readerDecision: Give museum tours and research-office visits their own arrival instructions.
counties.rationale: Combines purpose-specific opening days, a midday interruption and last-start preparation with a research-request route. Knox supplies the general service-versus-building distinction, Coke the last-activity distinction, and Amherst separate uses; the full local brief turns their intersection into an explicit Tuesday office-versus-tour acceptance check.

counties.name: Douglas County
counties.readerDecision: Compare the group’s finished artwork and participation before choosing a workshop.
counties.rationale: The proposed page adds collaborative-versus-individual artifact choice before capacity and artist review. Hoke covers turns within an experience, Cook registration channels and Mille Lacs core/add-on capacities; none makes the group’s finished-work ownership and immediate take-home expectation the first commissioning decision.

counties.name: Dundy County
counties.readerDecision: Keep the clinic branch and its time zone attached to the appointment route.
counties.rationale: The timed-booking guide names time zones for an individual attraction; this page works through changing among branches under one organization and retaining location context at a shared contact. Knox and Olmsted cover service purpose and hours but do not develop the branch-switch zone check.

counties.name: Fillmore County
counties.readerDecision: Explain where an audience sits before relying on the theatre’s total capacity.
counties.rationale: Kay separates room/setup capacity, Cleveland separates production from room hire and Pickett maps bedrooms by level. This local brief adds the decision between main-floor and balcony audience arrangements, with a concrete count check and verified seating-plan requirement rather than summing inconsistent row figures.

counties.name: Franklin County
counties.readerDecision: Apply holiday notices to the departments they actually affect.
counties.rationale: Goes beyond general service-hours labeling by defining dated exception scope and partial-day behavior across departments. Huntingdon attaches a seasonal status to an outlet; this brief adds a holiday table whose scope must not overwrite a separately published continuous service.

counties.name: Frontier County
counties.readerDecision: Explain the required break before extending a campground itinerary.
counties.rationale: Calhoun already connects maximum stay length to the appropriate campground category, and Crow Wing connects monthly eligibility to site configuration. This local brief applies the shared stay-fit principle to a required interruption: the camper and vehicle must leave the entire camping area for twenty-four hours. Its useful project detail is explaining that departure beside the rate and inquiry route, with day-counting left to the operator; it does not claim a new general principle.

counties.name: Furnas County
counties.readerDecision: Separate playable-course status from the greens a golfer expects to use.
counties.rationale: Huntingdon attaches seasonal closure to the affected outlet and service; Murray distinguishes suspended guided access from continuing visits. This local brief applies the same precise-status principle to a course that may remain playable on temporary fairway greens. It separates the playing surface, temperature-dependent opening and tee-time route without treating the presence of a booking link as a promise of regular greens.

counties.name: Gage County
counties.readerDecision: Explain when a larger school group needs separate visit days.
counties.rationale: Freeborn and Mille Lacs work through rotations and activity limits, while Kiowa distinguishes host/class details for mobile delivery. Gage adds the explicit multiple-day branch and a check preventing the website from inventing same-day rotations from total capacity.

counties.name: Garden County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish year-round grounds from seasonal or appointment-based interior visits.
counties.rationale: The full Delaware trail/museum and Madison winter-building records already explain the essential choice; Murray covers restricted guided versus continuing visits. Ash Hollow’s named time zone and appointment route do not yield enough extra project guidance to justify a separate page after those comparisons. The alternate dumpster notice is too thin.

counties.name: Garfield County
counties.readerDecision: Explain the working-ranch experience before a guest chooses accommodation.
counties.rationale: Pushmataha and Pickett explain sleeping layout, while Clarke separates horse facilities from owner care. This brief makes the working-ranch participation model the first fit decision, then tests an accommodation substitution with a different bathroom arrangement; it does not treat ranch photographs as a fixed activity package.

counties.name: Gosper County
counties.readerDecision: Keep tournament players, meal guests and service times as separate planning facts.
counties.rationale: Lincoln distinguishes activity units and Okmulgee distinguishes estimate from guarantee; this brief adds parallel counts for golfers and diners plus independent golf/meal times within one event request. Bremer’s staffing comparison does not carry these multiple counts through a tournament handoff.

counties.name: Grant County
counties.readerDecision: Explain how a book-club kit stays with its responsible group from request to return.
counties.rationale: Wharton explains title-request and collection routes, Dickens card service scope and Concho support membership. This brief adds group custody of a complete kit, registered contacts and desk return with a contents check; its reader task continues beyond locating an individual book.

counties.name: Greeley County
counties.readerDecision: Keep returning and new vendor instructions tied to the correct festival year.
counties.rationale: Pittsburg separates indoor/outdoor partners and annual forms, while the event-update guide distinguishes ended and future invitations. This brief adds applicant-history categories with different deadlines inside the year transition, and checks archived direct document links before the next cycle opens.

counties.name: Hall County
counties.readerDecision: Separate the school’s booking estimate from visit-day billing and chaperone preparation.
counties.rationale: Mille Lacs and Freeborn center program capacity and rotations. Okmulgee turns an estimate into a pre-event guarantee. Stuhr instead documents a later chaperone list and visit-day invoicing count; the proposed sequence preserves those differences and explains separate chaperone payment without importing catering guarantee rules.

counties.name: Hamilton County
counties.readerDecision: Check the host room and turnover time before requesting a mobile science program.
counties.rationale: Kiowa distinguishes mobile-program host types and class counts; Mille Lacs separates activity capacity; Beltrami separates room time from a visit. The complete Hamilton brief combines physical host-room fit, host-supplied infrastructure and setup/pack-down occupancy, including a distinct show-versus-turnover test.

counties.name: Harlan County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish a multi-day boat rental from permission to use it at night.
counties.rationale: McIntosh distinguishes blocks and preparation, including an actual 24-hour option. Harlan instead tests a multi-day choice that expressly excludes night operation, leaving overnight custody unresolved. Lawrence and Cherokee coordinate separate stay/activity reservations and do not answer this daily-use boundary.

counties.name: Hayes County
counties.readerDecision: Explain the two bills behind a bulk-beef deposit before checkout.
counties.rationale: Madison explains farm/processor stages and harvest versus collection, Jasper instruction deadlines, and Lawrence shared cutting constraints. This draft adds the financial preparation absent from those complete records: separate payees and invoices plus hanging-weight versus take-home-quantity labels before the deposit decision.

counties.name: Hitchcock County
counties.readerDecision: Keep a boat-access closure in force until the responsible operator confirms the change.
counties.rationale: Kittson already separates open camping from closed lake recreation and explicitly prevents a future construction target from automatically reopening access. This brief applies that established principle to Swanson Reservoir: identify both affected ramps, retain the overall boating-access restriction, and avoid implying that one repaired ramp or the arrival of spring resolves every restriction. Its value is a complete local implementation brief, not novel reopening guidance.

counties.name: Holt County
counties.readerDecision: Show the supported payment route before a customer enters the online store.
counties.rationale: Cook separates course-registration channels and Love explains package units. This brief connects product categories to an explicitly unsupported checkout payment method and a credential-free direct inquiry. It adds a concrete acceptance check without claiming new payment integration or benefits eligibility.

counties.name: Hooker County
counties.readerDecision: Keep an event-room agreement separate from first-come camper hookups.
counties.rationale: Faribault separates facility-request types, Cherokee separates floats from stays and Nash separates event/stay use. Hooker adds a guaranteed room date alongside unreserved first-come camper sites and an outside full-service referral, with a guest-facing check that the organizer cannot pass room confirmation off as campsite allocation.

counties.name: Howard County
counties.readerDecision: Plan the private event around its own space and time.
counties.rationale: Pine handles different public service hours and Johnson handles general venue requirements. This brief joins a timed private ceremony, photographs and a separately hired reception into an owner-supplied event outline.

counties.name: Jefferson County
counties.readerDecision: Choose grounds access or an indoor historical visit.
counties.rationale: Delaware already distinguishes trail access from museum admission; Iowa Madison handles an open museum and closed birthplace; Rice handles separately arranged sites. The depot alternative adds ordinary appointment and room-inquiry routes without enough additional project detail.

counties.name: Johnson County
counties.readerDecision: Help families describe the swimming lesson they need before registration.
counties.rationale: Sangamon distinguishes registration privilege and waitlist order. The Tecumseh brief adds instructor-owned level comparison and class viability, with a concrete boundary between information and placement.

counties.name: Kearney County
counties.readerDecision: Quote the event setup as well as the room.
counties.rationale: Stearns covers layout-specific capacity and Sherburne room combinations. Here theatre dining and board-table seating create two distinct acceptance tests, with the complete event setup feeding the quote.

counties.name: Keith County
counties.readerDecision: Explain what a camping reservation actually selects.
counties.rationale: Clayton handles unreleased dates, Black Hawk booking status versus physical occupancy, and Marshall inventory subsets. This brief combines different release windows with an area-level product whose capacity changes with water levels.

counties.name: Keya Paha County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish public campground facilities and reservation contacts.
counties.rationale: Minnesota Lincoln already handles seasonal accommodation facilities and Watonwan separates campsite and shelter arrangements. Falls distinguishes public library service from support. Neither local lead adds enough commissioning detail to support a new page.

counties.name: Kimball County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a staffed visit from arranged access.
counties.rationale: Rice already covers distinct museum sites and arrangements, and Pine service-specific availability. The library adds phone-arranged locker pickup but not enough documented request or exception detail for a substantial county brief. The completed alternative review supports NO_ADDITION; the initial golf lead is abandoned rather than approved.

counties.name: Knox County
counties.readerDecision: Show what guests must arrange for an equestrian stay.
counties.rationale: Minnesota Lincoln distinguishes accommodation seasons and Hardeman packing inclusions. Niobrara adds an owner-reviewed preparation boundary for a guest bringing horses, rather than a generic amenities comparison.

counties.name: Lancaster County
counties.readerDecision: Separate making the project yourself from commissioning a maker.
counties.rationale: Wood concerns equipment badging and Greenville membership access. This page adds the customer-versus-maker decision and a concrete commission brief, preserving the separate training route.

counties.name: Lincoln County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the group visit by purpose and party size.
counties.rationale: Kaufman separates group inquiry from public admission; this local page gives three intersecting product ranges and tests that prevent borrowing another product’s limits.

counties.name: Logan County
counties.readerDecision: Explain the sleeping arrangement behind the guest count.
counties.rationale: Ontonagon and Menifee already explain beds versus bedrooms and convertible shared space; Pushmataha compares sleeping privacy across units. This local brief applies that established method to a single one-bedroom rental offered for day, week or month stays, with an owner-approved layout and duration-preserving inquiry. Its value is the complete local commissioning example, not a new sleeping-layout principle.

counties.name: Loup County
counties.readerDecision: Check the whole river-trip party before choosing equipment.
counties.rationale: Allamakee separates rental and shuttle inclusions; Dent handles unit-specific pet rules. This brief adds a rule spanning equipment across a mixed party, with a concrete whole-group test.

counties.name: Madison County
counties.readerDecision: Explain when the gathering space depends on a hotel stay.
counties.rationale: Stearns and Sherburne cover capacity and room combinations; Dallas covers lodging arrival. This local brief concerns dependency between meeting-space hire and accommodation, including a fixed-period six-room package.

counties.name: McPherson County
counties.readerDecision: Keep fair entry information tied to its year and project category.
counties.rationale: Scurry already handles dated event roles and deadlines. This brief adds the lifecycle from project entry through category letters, assignments and show order, with document-owner responsibilities.

counties.name: Merrick County
counties.readerDecision: Choose the trail access point before following directions.
counties.rationale: Hudspeth already distinguishes trailhead arrival from the visitor center, and Delaware separates outdoor access from other facilities. Pine already handles service-specific hours. The alternatives do not justify repeating those complete briefs.

counties.name: Morrill County
counties.readerDecision: Separate a campsite from a reserved group facility.
counties.rationale: Decatur and Throckmorton cover first-come camping and payment; Watonwan separates shelter and campsite processes. The lodging alternative adds amenity labels without enough owner-confirmed inquiry detail.

counties.name: Nance County
counties.readerDecision: Choose a museum visit or a research inquiry.
counties.rationale: McLennan covers public, group and research schedules; Rice separate arrangements; Andrew bounded research requests. The alternative camping information does not add enough project guidance beyond existing camping records.

counties.name: Nemaha County
counties.readerDecision: Keep available lodging distinct from a suspended excursion.
counties.rationale: Adair and Iowa Madison separate seasonal components. The local project adds an explicit suspended product, remaining lodging offer and a cross-page dependency review rather than a single hours correction.

counties.name: Nuckolls County
counties.readerDecision: Distinguish a public tasting from a production-area visit.
counties.rationale: Roseau covers museum versus production tours; Pine separates operating hours. This brief joins tour extent and private-event purpose into two concrete inquiry routes with different owner-supplied information.

counties.name: Otoe County
